verified_behavior: The app adds a separate AEON3 Georges Basin route and does not relabel or overwrite the historical MOSAiC v1/v2 study.
The packaged AEON artifact is generated only from five exact independent development outcome reviews whose byte digests are hard-pinned.
The target is labelled source-reported conditioned 38 kHz Sv_mean over the published 60minFullDepth nominal 0-200 m product; independent field calibration and source-clock UTC are not claimed.

The page labels all values TRAIN/validation development, distinguishes post-hoc arms, states no model selection or final evaluation, and makes no SOTA, biomass, species, catch or operational-value claim.
The release exposes no AEON cached forecast and offers no AEON forecast action.

independent_execution.python_tests: 16 passed in 7.28s for AEON release and read-only API tests

limitations: This review covers the development-only app state before the reviewed ADR 0011 selection and before any CAL or retrospective TEST outcome; it is not approval of a final scientific release.
A later release that adds selection, calibrated intervals or final evaluation must update the evidence surface, bind those new artifacts and receive a new independent review.
The displayed validation values are descriptive and selection-optimistic; the app correctly serves no operational AEON forecast in this state.
